tbesh_html:
1) to mock, deride, ridicule
1a) (Qal) to mock, deride, have in derision
1b) (Niphal) to stammer
1c) (Hiphil) to mock, deride

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly
strongs_1890.kjv_def: have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.
